question.text: A trust purchases Sovereign Gold Bonds during a fiscal year. What is the maximum quantity of gold (in grams) that the trust can subscribe to in that fiscal year?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook sets the trust and similar entity subscription limit at 20 kg per fiscal year, distinct from the 4 kg limit for individuals and HUFs. The Trap: 4 kg is the individual/HUF limit, not the trust limit. Trusts also do not enjoy the tax-free redemption treatment that individuals get: redemption gains for non-individual investors are taxable as LTCG if held for more than 12 months. Note: Based on NISM Series X-B workbook pp.265-266, which set the entity-wise subscription limits and the redemption tax treatment for non-individual investors.
